## Reader content and search decision

The editorial calendar called for a substantial 2026-08-16 reader asset answering where readers can discover English web fiction beyond one platform. Pull request #92 delivered that asset as `docs/blog/posts/2026-08-16-english-web-fiction-ecosystem.md`.

The article maps platform-native discovery, cross-platform indexes, forum story libraries, reader communities, newsletters, author-run sites, translation-oriented recommendation layers, and public catalogs into a reusable reader path. Its research set contains 30 primary/platform/community references and 26 academic/research references, with an explicit method section, counterevidence/sample-boundary discussion, original synthesis, conclusion, and complete references. A final negative/defensive-language scan found no remaining targeted author-prose constructions. Sider Scholar checks independently recovered core academic references including Henry Jenkins and Ravi Purushotma's participatory-culture work and David B. Nieborg and Thomas Poell's platformization study.

The article links directly to the `English Web-Fiction Discovery Starter` introduced by pull request #91. The generated `gh-pages` artifact contains the exact article title, canonical URL, GA4 output, and a primary CTA to `https://app.webnovel.win/?repos=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.webnovel.win%2Fsources%2Fenglish-web-fiction-discovery-starter`. The publishing workflow verified the public documentation build identity at exact commit `bc691fa5b53d8eb5614f33e30a1b4d7397f70e77`.

Search Console evidence remains unavailable, so no speculative title, keyword, canonical, routing, or CTR experiment is justified. The canonical topology remains `https://www.webnovel.win/` for editorial/search identity and `https://app.webnovel.win/` for the reader runtime.

## Source discovery and admission audits

The 2026-08-16 source program was completed through pull request #91 before the article merge. It added five fresh cross-platform/community discovery targets to a WebNR-maintained link-only starter: Top Web Fiction, SpaceBattles Discover Stories, Sufficient Velocity Story Library, Reddit Serials Story Directory, and r/HFY. All five are represented only by verified public landing URLs, WebNR-authored descriptions, and discovery labels; WebNR does not mirror or ingest their story text, comments, rankings, profile data, or other user-generated content.

### Top Web Fiction — pass as link-only discovery

Current public evidence identifies Top Web Fiction as a community-run listing for online serials and indie fiction with reader boosts, weekly/all-time views, tags, and new listings. Its value is cross-platform discovery, including author-hosted works.

**Decision:** retain as a link-only discovery target. Do not copy rankings, descriptions, or hosted work text. Any richer adapter would require a separate source-specific contract for identity, cadence, attribution, rights, and update/deletion behavior.

### SpaceBattles Discover Stories — pass as link-only discovery

The current public library spans original and fan fiction and exposes structured discovery around stories and forum threads. Current site terms/rules treat the underlying material as user-generated content and preserve creator rights while governing site use.

**Decision:** retain only the public discovery link and WebNR-authored metadata. Do not ingest forum/story text, threadmarks, comments, profiles, or media. Origin-site moderation, warnings, accounts, and work-specific rights remain authoritative.

### Sufficient Velocity Story Library — pass as link-only discovery

The current Story Library exposes public user-fiction discovery with tags, status, word-count, forum, and original-fiction filters. It remains a community surface whose story text, discussions, accounts, warnings, and permissions belong to the origin site.

**Decision:** retain as a link-only discovery target with no runtime crawl or copy. A richer integration requires explicit rights/access fixtures and a bounded machine-interface contract.

### Reddit Serials Story Directory — bounded pass as link-only directory

The public directory still exposes an ongoing-serial catalog organized around community-maintained story links and genre/author groupings.

**Decision:** retain only the directory landing page and authored discovery description. Community-maintained metadata can age, so readers should confirm each target work's current origin and status.

### r/HFY — bounded pass as community discovery

The public community combines original one-shots, serialized fiction, series conventions, reader discovery, and community indexes.

**Decision:** retain only a link to the public community surface. Do not copy posts, comments, author indexes, or story text.

A secondary future-research queue was also identified from public discovery work: LitFic's public catalog/RSS surfaces, Betakyte's serialized-fiction discovery feeds, Hungry's Hedgerow author-site RSS, Ream's free/paid serial-fiction platform, and Laterpress serial-fiction surfaces. These remain research leads until source-specific rights, access, stable identity, paging/feed semantics, request cadence, attribution, and update behavior are audited.

## Decisions

- **Technical:** preserve the existing Quality gates, exact build identities, independent documentation publication, and bounded propagation checks; no new product repair is indicated today.
- **Content:** publish the scheduled 2026-08-16 English web-fiction ecosystem guide; use its cross-platform discovery path as the substantial reader asset for this cycle.
- **Source:** keep the five pull request #91 destinations strictly link-only; defer richer adapters until source-specific rights/access and machine-interface fixtures exist. Keep LitFic, Betakyte, Hungry's Hedgerow, Ream, and Laterpress as future research leads.
- **Search:** preserve canonical topology and avoid speculative search-facing changes while Search Console evidence is unavailable.
- **Community:** record independent references and stale cache text as evidence only; perform no outreach without a clear reader benefit and policy-safe path.
- **Measurement:** preserve `G-DGH8HNQKE4`, full-URL application page-view behavior, disabled signals/ad personalization, and the rule that missing provider evidence is unavailable rather than zero.
